newsitem.title: USA: Ethical Holding licenses morphine tablet.
newsitem.headline: Ethical Holding licenses morphine tablet.

text.p: Drug delivery group Ethical Holding Plc said on Thursday it signed a license and development pact with Boehringer Ingelheim for its once-daily sustained release morphine tablet.
Ethical said in a statement Boehringer Ingelheim had been granted exclusive rights to market the tablet everywhere except Japan, the United States and Canada.
Ethical's tablet, intended for the treatment of severe pain, used its patented sustained release Multipor technology, Ethical said.
It was in Phase III clinical trials in both Europe and the United States and was licensed in the United States to an undisclosed partner, the company said.

Boehriger Ingelheim is a pharmaceutical copmany also in the field of palliative medecine and markets a range of oral morphine preparations, including Ethical's twice-daily controlled release morphine tablets.
